note: Wabaunsee County (FIPS 20197) parcels are not published as a queryable service or file. Its ORKA status layer lists it as Map-Public, but the ORKA viewer draws no parcel REST layer we could query. The statewide KS_Parcels_ORKA and KS_Parcels_ORKA_EB services hold no Wabaunsee parcels (EB covers only CN, RA, SH, TH; KS_Parcels_ORKA has address points, subdivisions, lots and an opaque tile index with no query support). Parcel data is available only by PORKA request with registration and approval; the county parcel search is a registered-user portal; other sources are commercial vendors.
